mission.title: Recon and Retrieval
mission.description: Resupply an internal base for Zion.

phase.briefing:
I hate to ask this of you, but no one else is available right now. We need you to re-supply one of our bases in the Matrix.
Go to this address and pick up the code fragments that Hadar has on hand. Be careful, Warrior. The Exiles have been making a habit of attempting to steal our transfers.

enter.say: Hadar is inside. He should be able to tell you where the Fragments are stored.

phase.briefing: I have a lock on her position right now. Adhara has already paired up with a small band of Exiles in this district. Make your way there and recover those fragments!

enter.say: This is the place ... It looks like there are a few Exiles here with Adhara. Take her out and get those frags back.

objective.text: Take the fragments from Adhara's computer

phase.briefing: I'm sending you the address of the next location now.

enter.say: We have a problem. It appears that before you killed Adhara they gave up the location of this base and the Exiles that she was siding with hit us -- hard! I'm glad you're here because we need you to kill the remaining Exiles and rescue two survivors. After you've done that, get the survivors and the frags to a hardline and upload them. Good luck!

objective.text: Lead the Zion Operatives out of the building
Lead the Zion Operatives to a hardline
Upload the data fragments through a hardline
Do not let either hostage die
